import ctypes
from ctypes import c_double, c_void_p, c_char_p, c_size_t, CFUNCTYPE, POINTER

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_root_fsolver_type structure
class gsl_root_fsolver_type(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ('name', c_char_p),
        ('size', c_size_t),
        ('set', CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, c_void_p, c_void_p, POINTER(c_double), c_double, c_double)),
        ('iterate', CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, c_void_p, c_void_p, POINTER(c_double), POINTER(c_double), POINTER(c_double)))
    ]

# Define the gsl_root_fsolver structure
class gsl_root_fsolver(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ('type', POINTER(gsl_root_fsolver_type)),
        ('state', c_void_p),
        ('function', c_void_p),
        ('x_lower', c_double),
        ('x_upper', c_double),
        ('root', c_double)
    ]

# Define the function prototypes
alloc = gsl.gsl_root_fsolver_alloc
alloc.argtypes = [POINTER(gsl_root_fsolver_type)]
alloc.restype = POINTER(gsl_root_fsolver)

name = gsl.gsl_root_fsolver_name
name.argtypes = [POINTER(gsl_root_fsolver)]
name.restype = c_char_p

free = gsl.gsl_root_fsolver_free
free.argtypes = [POINTER(gsl_root_fsolver)]
free.restype = None

# Test function
def assert_test():
    # Create a dummy solver type
    dummy_set_func = CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, c_void_p, c_void_p, POINTER(c_double), c_double, c_double)(lambda *args: 0)
    dummy_iterate_func = CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, c_void_p, c_void_p, POINTER(c_double), POINTER(c_double), POINTER(c_double))(lambda *args: 0)
    dummy_type = gsl_root_fsolver_type(b"dummy", 0, dummy_set_func, dummy_iterate_func)
    dummy_type_ptr = ctypes.pointer(dummy_type)

    # Allocate the solver
    solver = alloc(dummy_type_ptr)
    assert solver is not None, "Solver allocation failed"

    # Get the name of the solver
    solver_name = name(solver)
    assert solver_name == b"dummy", f"Expected 'dummy', got {solver_name}"

    # Free the solver
    free(solver)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
